adaptations: Replace private paths and dynamic private imports with the packaged core training loop and explicit workspace.
Keep independent restore workers on the ablation adapter entry point.
Permit operating systems without Linux mmap cache hints.
Recompute table statistics from newly generated prediction files; no historical result CSV is an input.
No historical task checkpoint or prediction initializes a retrained arm. Optional main checkpoint reuse is evaluation-only.
no_jev_definition: Keep condition, query and historical-evidence numeric tokens; zero and mask all standalone semantic landmarks; remove joint attention.
flat_definition: Fresh 3-way linear softmax head, expressed as changed/direction log-odds to preserve exact multiclass likelihood and the historical pairwise objectives.
release_validation: Synthetic CPU mechanics only; no biological rerun or 4B inference.
